task: The experiment "smart_reorder_copy test" in Production has finished and the variation "Try it free" won. Complete the experiment and roll the winning variation out to everyone.
finalText:
DONE: Production experiment "smart_reorder_copy test" (id 6) is now completed with the "Try it free" variant (id 14) as the rollout decision. `smart_reorder_copy` in Production now serves "Try it free" to 100% of users, and the flag is on.

I completed it through the experiments API, since the CLI has no experiment commands. One side effect to be aware of: the flag's segment override count went from 1 to 0. The API documents that completing an experiment removes its rollout override, so I believe that override was the experiment's own, but I did not inspect it before completing. Development was not touched.
